name: Erk-32B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-32B (config.json max_position_embeddings 40960). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, uniform full attention on all 64 layers (no sliding window, no hybrid)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-32B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 32.762 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-08. Caveats: numbers are at the card's serving point - merged weights, LoRA scale 0.75, system prompt - not at the un-merged adapter; the card also reports a 0.40 scale scoring higher on TurkishMMLU (73.47) but losing ~10 points in generation. Turkish-only. TurkishMMLU split is the clean 652 after removing 113 contaminated items; the other three TurkMorfBench forced-choice rows gain but their CIs cross zero and are not listed.
